notes.plain: The projection theorem supplies feasibility of the actual selected point p. Move its movement-square term in the sharp one-step inequality to the left and drop the nonnegative final comparator-distance magnitude. Expand inner(g,p-u), cancel the same arbitrary offset b, and use norm(x-u)=norm(u-x). Thus this selected p minimizes the known-current affine proximal objective overV; no argmin oracle is assumed.
